dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, following a smooth parabolic curve.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical structural deviations or bulges along the visible edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate grey/dark-grey skin tone across the dorsal plane with visible low-intensity specular highlights.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, subtle dark mottling and linear skin-fold textures localized primarily in the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the primary slate-grey pigmentation and slightly darker textural variations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One small, circular pale mark on the mid-left dorsal region; several faint linear marks visible on the posterior section.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, dark linear indentation or deep vertical crease is visible along the central dorsal axis toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular depigmented mark on the upper-left dorsal quadrant; distinct vertical linear mark on the posterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, open blowhole at the anterior end with high contrast against the dorsal skin.
